title: Frontend: Mobile-responsive layout for all pages
description: Audit and fix all pages and components to work correctly on mobile viewports (375px+). Focus on layout, touch interactions, and readability.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard: single-column card grid on mobile
Sidebar: hidden on mobile, accessible via hamburger → Sheet drawer
Project detail: tabs scroll horizontally on mobile (no wrapping)
Milestones/Todos: full-width on mobile, drag-drop still works
Timeline: readable and usable on mobile
All modals/dialogs fit within mobile viewport
No horizontal scroll on any page
Verify in browser using Playwright at 375px viewport

steps.details: Use Playwright or DevTools to check each page at 375x812 viewport. Log any overflow, cut-off content, or unusable interactions. Create a fix list.
In AppLayout: on mobile (< lg breakpoint), hide sidebar. Add hamburger menu button in a top header bar. Clicking opens sidebar as Sheet (shadcn/ui) from the left.

steps.description: Fix tab overflow on project detail
steps.details: Wrap Tabs list in a horizontally scrollable container: overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap. This allows all 7 tabs to be accessible via swipe.

steps.description: Fix dialogs and modals for mobile
steps.details: Ensure all Dialog components use max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto for mobile. The create project wizard should be full-screen on mobile.

steps.description: Verify in browser using Playwright at 375px
steps.details: Run through all main user flows at 375px viewport. Verify no horizontal scroll. Verify all actions are usable without zooming.
